synthetic_tests.fixtures: Temporary synthetic audit sessions under work; removed after tests. No manuscript/image files or live audit helper calls.

protection.concurrent_root_change: Root explicitly reported scan132 finalization during this task; changes.md, doubts.md, inventory.csv and progress.log changed as that new page was finalized. No existing page/record pair changed.

protocol.clock: actual UTC with microseconds; no caller-supplied phase timestamps
protocol.order: audit began <= image-first observed < text opened < audit completed

limitations: Declarations record root observations and intent to open text; they do not prove human viewing or actual viewer access.
Existing audit completion timestamps have second precision; completion in the same second as text opening cannot satisfy strict ordering.
Read-only receipt validation supplements existing map-order/history/freeze checks; existing scripts were not modified to invoke it.
scope: Mechanical helper, documentation and synthetic evidence only. No scans, witness prose, context, transcription review, live audit/receipt/freeze events or changes to existing page/record/combined bytes.
